name: Magmar Armor Set
description: Blessed armor from the Magmar dimension
fullDescription: The Magmar Armor Set is a blessed collection of netherite armor pieces obtained from the dangerous Magmar dimension. Each piece is unbreakable and provides exceptional protection against all forms of damage, especially fire.

sections.title: Armor Pieces
content: Magmar Helmet - Protection VII, Aqua Affinity III, Respiration III
Magmar Chestplate - Protection VII, Thorns II
Magmar Leggings - Protection VII, Swift Sneak V
Magmar Boots - Protection VII, Soul Speed IV, Feather Falling VI

sections.title: Enchantments (All Pieces)
content: Fire Protection VI - Excellent fire resistance

sections.title: Set Bonus
content: 4 pieces: Maximum fire resistance + movement bonuses

name: Menacing Magmar Helmet
description: Magmar Helmet combined with the Emperor's Crown
fullDescription: The Menacing Magmar Helmet is a powerful fusion of the standard Magmar Helmet and the Emperor's Crown. This unique piece combines the protective properties of Magmar armor with additional combat bonuses, making it superior to the standard helmet.

sections.title: Enchantments
content: Aqua Affinity II - Faster underwater mining

sections.title: Special Features
content: Grants combat bonuses unlike normal armor

name: Corrupted Armor Set
description: Corrupted Upgrade For The Magmar Armor Forged With Corrupted Scales
fullDescription: The Corrupted Armor Set represents the ultimate evolution of Magmar armor, enhanced with Corrupted Scales. This dark armor channels corruption energy while providing unmatched protection.

sections.title: Armor Pieces
content: Corrupted Helmet - Upgraded Menacing Magmar Helmet

sections.title: Enchantments (All Pieces)
content: Fire Protection VII - Maximum fire resistance
Aqua Affinity III - Fast underwater mining

sections.title: Special Features
content: Best armor set in the game

name: Corrupted Helmet
description: Corrupted Upgrade For The Menacing Magmar Helmet
fullDescription: The Corrupted Helmet is the ultimate head protection, combining the Menacing Magmar Helmet with Corrupted Scales. This dark crown channels corruption while providing maximum defense.

sections.title: Enchantments
content: Aqua Affinity III - Fast underwater mining

name: Bandit Tunic
description: A leather tunic taken from the corpse of a bandit
fullDescription: The Bandit Tunic is a red leather chestplate that was stripped from a fallen bandit. While it provides basic protection, its unbreakable nature makes it useful for early-game players.

name: Daylight Armor Set
description: The sacred armor of the Trollhunter
fullDescription: Forged by Merlin himself, this armor protects the Trollhunter from corruption and grants clarity in battle. Summoned alongside the Daylight blade when the Amulet is placed in a crafting table.

name: Eclipse Armor Set
description: Enhanced Daylight armor transformed by Triumbric Stones
fullDescription: The ultimate form of Trollhunter armor, reinforced with the power of three Triumbric Stones. Withstands even Gunmar's mightiest strikes and grants immunity to his intimidation.
